does_the_7x_hold.claim: docs/MERGE-SPEED.md: cold 1030126 ms against warm 138988 ms (7.4x)
does_the_7x_hold.found: NO, not as a full-gate comparison. Both of those runs stopped inside self-update on the wrapper defect (section 3b), so 'warm 138.99 s' is the first ~2.5 minutes of a gate that then died - it never ran cli, memory-update, tools, sessions, recovery-cli, plugins, fixtures, subagents, ui-js or ui-browser. On this tree tonight a COMPLETE cold gate is 1625532 ms and a COMPLETE warm gate 825069 ms: a saving of 800463 ms (13.3 min) per landing, about 2x, not 7x. The mechanism is worth landing on that number: the gate lane is capacity 1, so the landing's cost in the queue falls from ~27 min to ~14 min.
does_the_7x_hold.also: the cold gate's own duration is machine-dependent (797.5 s build here against 839.6 s in the delivery's run); the pair above is the trustworthy comparison because the two runs are minutes apart on one tree and one candidate.

restored_run_1.outcome: FAILED, for a DIFFERENT reason: 'AssertionError: the node reported busy while the subagent ran (reserved capacity)' at scripts/test-job-subagents.cjs:38, i.e. the jobs proof. Not an invalidation failure and not a verdict line.

restored_run_2.outcome: PASS on the same candidate tree, warm tree reused

false_green_falsification.conclusion: the mechanism is not a false-green machine: a content change in the merged tree reaches the warm gate as a red verdict, and removing it returns the gate to green.
